mapper.sql: WITH action_period AS ( SELECT strategy_option_id, MIN(start_date) AS planned_start_date, MAX(end_date) AS planned_end_date FROM strategy_action WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY strategy_option_id ), final_ranked AS ( SELECT selection.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY selection.strategy_case_id ORDER BY selection.created_at DESC, selection.final_selection_id DESC ) AS selection_rank FROM final_strategy_selection selection WHERE selection.is_deleted = 0 ), eligible_selection AS ( SELECT selection.final_selection_id, selection.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.sku_id, period.planned_start_date, period.planned_end_date FROM final_ranked selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 AND strategy_case.case_status IN ('READY_TO_EXECUTE', 'EXECUTING', 'EXECUTION_COMPLETED') JOIN action_period period ON period.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id WHERE selection.selection_rank = 1 AND period.planned_start_date <= #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} )

WITH action_period AS ( SELECT strategy_option_id, MIN(start_date) AS planned_start_date, MAX(end_date) AS planned_end_date FROM strategy_action WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY strategy_option_id ), final_ranked AS ( SELECT selection.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY selection.strategy_case_id ORDER BY selection.created_at DESC, selection.final_selection_id DESC ) AS selection_rank FROM final_strategy_selection selection WHERE selection.is_deleted = 0 ), eligible_selection AS ( SELECT selection.final_selection_id, selection.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.sku_id, period.planned_start_date, period.planned_end_date FROM final_ranked selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 AND strategy_case.case_status IN ('READY_TO_EXECUTE', 'EXECUTING', 'EXECUTION_COMPLETED') JOIN action_period period ON period.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id WHERE selection.selection_rank = 1 AND period.planned_start_date <= #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} ), relevant_sales_point AS ( SELECT DISTINCT scope.strategy_case_id, scope.strategy_option_id, scope.sales_point_id FROM ( SELECT selection.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, snapshot.sales_point_id FROM eligible_selection selection JOIN strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 WHERE snapshot.sales_point_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT selection.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, action.source_sales_point_id FROM eligible_selection selection JOIN strategy_action action ON action.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 WHERE action.source_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT selection.strategy_case_id, selection.strategy_option_id, action.target_sales_point_id FROM eligible_selection selection JOIN strategy_action action ON action.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 WHERE action.target_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL ) scope ), scoped_sales AS ( SELECT selection.final_selection_id, selection.strategy_option_id, selection.sku_id, sales.sales_daily_id, sales.sales_date, sales.sales_point_id, sales.net_sales_qty, sales.net_sales_amount FROM eligible_selection selection JOIN relevant_sales_point point ON point.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND point.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id JOIN sales_daily sales ON sales.sku_id = selection.sku_id AND sales.sales_point_id = point.sales_point_id AND sales.sales_date BETWEEN selection.planned_start_date AND LEAST(selection.planned_end_date, #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE}) AND sales.is_deleted = 0 ), priced_sales AS ( SELECT sales.*, price.sku_channel_price_id, price.product_cost, price.payment_fee, price.logistics_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sales.final_selection_id, sales.sales_daily_id ORDER BY price.effective_from DESC, price.updated_at DESC, price.sku_channel_price_id DESC ) AS price_rank FROM scoped_sales sales LEFT JOIN sku_channel_price price ON price.sku_id = sales.sku_id AND price.sales_point_id = sales.sales_point_id AND price.effective_from <= sales.sales_date AND (price.effective_to IS NULL OR price.effective_to >= sales.sales_date) AND price.is_deleted = 0 ), daily_performance AS ( SELECT final_selection_id, strategy_option_id, sales_date AS performance_date, SUM(net_sales_qty) AS actual_sales_quantity, SUM(net_sales_amount) AS actual_revenue, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN sku_channel_price_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SUM( net_sales_amount - net_sales_qty * ( product_cost + COALESCE(payment_fee, 0) + COALESCE(logistics_cost, 0) ) ) END AS actual_contribution_margin FROM priced_sales WHERE price_rank = 1 GROUP BY final_selection_id, strategy_option_id, sales_date ), current_inventory AS ( SELECT selection.final_selection_id, COALESCE(SUM(balance.on_hand_qty), 0) AS actual_remaining_quantity FROM eligible_selection selection LEFT JOIN inventory_balance balance ON balance.sku_id = selection.sku_id AND balance.is_deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND snapshot.inventory_balance_id = balance.inventory_balance_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_action action WHERE action.strategy_option_id = selection.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 AND ( balance.warehouse_id IN (action.source_warehouse_id, action.destination_warehouse_id) OR balance.stock_sales_point_id IN (action.source_sales_point_id, action.target_sales_point_id) OR balance.allocated_sales_point_id IN (action.source_sales_point_id, action.target_sales_point_id) ) ) ) GROUP BY selection.final_selection_id ) SELECT performance.final_selection_id, performance.strategy_option_id, performance.performance_date, performance.actual_sales_quantity, performance.actual_revenue, performance.actual_contribution_margin, CASE WHEN performance.performance_date = #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} THEN inventory.actual_remaining_quantity ELSE 0 END AS actual_remaining_quantity FROM daily_performance performance JOIN current_inventory inventory ON inventory.final_selection_id = performance.final_selection_id
UNION ALL
SELECT selection.final_selection_id, selection.strategy_option_id, #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS performance_date, 0 AS actual_sales_quantity, 0 AS actual_revenue, 0 AS actual_contribution_margin, inventory.actual_remaining_quantity FROM eligible_selection selection JOIN current_inventory inventory ON inventory.final_selection_id = selection.final_selection_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM daily_performance performance WHERE performance.final_selection_id = selection.final_selection_id AND performance.performance_date = #{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) ORDER BY final_selection_id, performance_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_performance ( strategy_option_id, performance_date, actual_sales_qty, actual_revenue, actual_contribution_margin, actual_remaining_qty, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT #{row.strategyOptionId}, #{row.performanceDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.actualSalesQuantity}, #{row.actualRevenue}, #{row.actualContributionMargin}, #{row.actualRemainingQuantity}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{actorId}, #{actorId}, 0 FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_performance existing WHERE existing.strategy_option_id = #{row.strategyOptionId} AND existing.performance_date = #{row.performanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND existing.is_deleted = 0 )
